name: client-order-lifecycle-tracking-fulfillment
executionConcern: customer order lifecycle, preparation decisions, pickup, live tracking, delivery proof and cross-surface convergence
objective: Make every client order list/detail/tracking/pickup/delivery state a projection of the same legal DSH state machine changed by authorized partner, captain or operator actions.
truthOwner: DSH owns order/fulfillment/custody operational truth; other surfaces are authorized actors or readbacks, not parallel owners.

tasks.objective: Close customer-visible order and fulfillment state machine
tasks.currentProblem: Order screens include preparation, tracking, pickup and delivery proof, but static UI cannot prove partner/captain/operator transitions are legal, idempotent, isolated and immediately converge on the same customer readback.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace every client-visible order state/action to contract, backend transition, database constraint/event and authorized cross-surface writer; correct illegal transitions, stale overwrites, missing readback or local completion assumptions.
tasks.targetState: Customer order list/detail/tracking always reflects committed DSH state; pickup/delivery/cancellation/exception transitions are authorized, retry-safe and cannot expose another client's order/location/proof.
tasks.action: Fix state-machine and persistence ownership first, then cross-surface writers and finally client projections/deep links/readback.
mustNotChange: Do not duplicate partner/captain business truth in app-client.
Do not expose captain/location/proof outside authorized order scope.
Do not mark final state optimistically before canonical readback.
Do not expand independent partner/captain finance or workforce flows.
acceptanceCriteria: All legal cross-surface transitions converge to the same order version/state.
Forbidden/stale/duplicate transitions fail without corrupting order truth.
Client deep links resolve only authorized owned orders.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore a parallel truth source.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U004 implementation commit after owner correction, directly affected consumer migration, cleanup and all linked checks.
